content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online with crypto payments means bypassing conventional payment processors that often charge high fees and impose restrictions. Platforms like Gumroad take up to 10% on each sale, which can significantly cut into your profits. In contrast, using NOWPayments through COREMERCH only charges 0.5%. For a $97 product, at 100 sales a month, this difference can retain $921 in your pocket. This infrastructure empowers creators to maintain control over their finances and provide a direct line to their audience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The COREMERCH system leverages a combination of free and robust tools that work in tandem to facilitate the sale of beats online. By utilizing GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you create a seamless user experience. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring easy retrieval and management. Automated delivery is handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, while NOWPayments processes crypto payments in real-time, ensuring you receive instant payment confirmations.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional platforms are either unavailable or heavily restricted. Musicians, producers, and content creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and similar markets can now sell their beats without the fear of payment rejection or lost revenue to high fees. COREMERCH provides an alternative that allows these creators to thrive and engage with a global audience without unnecessary barriers.
Keep 99.5% of your sales revenue with our low fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH stack is composed of essential components that ensure a fluid operational experience. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script provide the necessary logic for transaction processing. Supabase acts as the database for order management, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts the digital products for easy delivery. Finally, NOWPayments enables the acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies, converting transactions at the time of purchase to minimize risks associated with volatility.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, choose your desired stack — either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. Next, set up your hosting environment using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Then, implement your backend logic with either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets, and finally, integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which offers all the blueprints and templates necessary to launch and scale your online store.
